scope: Super Soul 232-236 identity correction and PQ151-155 reward reconciliation
source_of_truth: Canonical Super Soul and PQ relationship layers
evidence: Current maintained Super Soul catalogue places 232-236 on raid/event Souls already represented canonically as 040/036/041/042/043.

The maintained 186-PQ reward guide lists PQ151 as I think I'm getting the hang of this. plus I'll keep adding a bit of power to my attacks!, PQ152 as I will put a stop to you, fiend!, PQ153 as There's more where that came from! plus You're not much of a fun fight!, and no Super Soul in the Basic Reward lists for PQ154 or PQ155.
Current DLC documentation corroborates the DLC13/DLC14 Super Soul inventories and does not support the removed PQ152-PQ155 names.
The repository already contained canonical records for the correctly identified PQ151-PQ153 Souls, so 232-236 were duplicate/misattributed placeholders rather than missing distinct items.
